title: Integration recipe
description: `.integration/recipe.json` in a service repository: what the blueprinter needs before it runs any of the service's code. Inputs and checks are not here; the setup CLI's `describe` returns them.

protocolVersion.description: The setup-CLI protocol version the setup CLI speaks.

id.description: Namespace for check ids, the manifest key and overlay file names.

requires.description: Tool version ranges the setup CLI needs on the machine.

install.description: Shell command run once in the clone before the first call.

entry.description: Shell command prefix; the blueprinter appends `<command> [checkId] [--rotate]`.

credential.description: Where the blueprinter issues the service bootstrap token for a run.

namespace.description: The operators KV namespace of each service stage, with the literal `<stage>` placeholder.

ttlMax.description: Longest token lifetime the service accepts, an ISO 8601 duration from PT1M to PT1H.

outputs.description: Values a fix returns, per stage. Tenant outputs go to a Worker secret (secret, api|web), wrangler vars (non-secret, api|web) or a CI_SECRET__ GitHub environment secret (ci). Instance outputs may also be non-secret Terraform input (terraform).

overlay.description: Folder of whole files applied through the overlay engine, relative to the repository root.
